QF.id: AIFM CII Investment Process and Governance_15

question.text: For processing an AIF registration application or scheme launch, SEBI requires that external members of the proposed Investment Committee be:

answer.text: Resident Indian citizens (non-resident Indians need further clarification from Government and RBI)
Any nationality with no residency condition
Only foreign nationals with global PE experience

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the SEBI circular cited in the workbook, external IC members must be resident Indian citizens for routine application processing. If the external members are non-resident Indian citizens, the application is processed only after clarification from the Government and RBI. The Trap: "Any nationality" ignores the SEBI residency requirement. "Retired SEBI officials" and "foreign nationals only" are not part of the workbook condition. Note: The workbook states the residency requirement and the NRI clarification route on page 238; no quantitative delay or staffing prescription is given.
